# Dario Casertano — Senior Full Stack Engineer

> Distributed systems, AI agents, industrial automation. Full stack across backend, frontend and real-time — from design to deployment. 15+ years of experience.

## Bio

Senior Full Stack Engineer with 15+ years of experience. Designs and builds distributed systems, autonomous AI agents and industrial automation solutions, covering the whole lifecycle: architecture, backend/frontend development, real-time and deployment.

### Core stack

Agentic AI, LangChain, OpenAI, RAG, TypeScript, Node.js, Vue, Next.js, React, Docker, Fastify, Laravel, Solidity, Ethers.js, WebRTC, MQTT, PWA.

## Services

- **Training** — PHP, Node.js, TypeScript
- **AI Agents** — autonomous agents, RAG, tool calling
- **Web & mobile apps** — PWA, SPA, offline-first applications
- **SME software** — management systems, workshops, resources
- **Monitoring & alerting** — IoT, telemetry, real-time notifications
- **API & backend** — REST, JWT, OAuth2, integrations
- **DevOps/Infrastructure** — Docker, Linux, Apache, PM2
- **CMS & migrations** — Strapi, data migrations
- **Blockchain** — smart contracts, NFT, on-chain marketplaces
- **Geospatial** — routing, isochrones, territorial coverage analysis

## Projects

- [Falco WS Environment](https://casertano.name/progetti/falco-ws-environment/) (Node.js, Vue, Docker, MQTT, PWA) — Integrated manufacturing platform: PWA management with Gantt, IoT monitoring via MQTT and Dolibarr ERP purchasing.
- [Mail Thinker AI](https://casertano.name/progetti/mail-thinker-ai/) (LangChain, OpenAI, Vue, Docker) — Autonomous AI agent for email: Gmail/IMAP, thread analysis, multi-format extraction, cost-aware decision loops.
- [Bitmonds](https://casertano.name/progetti/bitmonds/) (Solidity, Polygon, ERC-721, Vue, Node.js) — Virtual diamonds tokenized as ERC-721 NFTs on Polygon: on-chain marketplace, PWA back-office and automatic 3D rendering.
- [Disaster Relief Department](https://casertano.name/progetti/disaster-relief-department/) (Telegram Bot, GIS, OpenAI, Docker) — Near-real-time monitoring and distribution of weather and seismic alerts across the whole Italian territory.
- [Interactive territorial coverage map](https://casertano.name/progetti/mappa-interattiva-di-copertura-territoriale/) (Node.js, Fastify, Valhalla, Leaflet, Docker) — Reachability isochrones by car, bike and foot over OpenStreetMap for territorial coverage analysis.
- [Multi-context search engine with P2P sync](https://casertano.name/progetti/motore-di-ricerca-multi-contesto/) (Vue, WebRTC, PWA, Docker, Firebase) — Offline-first PWA unifying search engines with dedicated CSEs and syncing devices in real time via WebRTC P2P.
- [ISP customer onboarding platform](https://casertano.name/progetti/piattaforma-onboarding-clienti-isp/) (Laravel, Vue, TypeScript, PWA, Docker) — End-to-end ISP onboarding: from fiber coverage check to digitally signed contract, fully automated on a PWA.
- [Territorial management platform](https://casertano.name/progetti/piattaforma-gestione-territoriale/) (Vue, Node.js, Docker, Strapi 5) — System for organizations with branches, shifts and resources: two PWAs, Telegram bot, reporting and maintenance on a containerized MariaDB backend.
- [Moodle e-learning platform](https://casertano.name/progetti/piattaforma-e-learning-moodle/) (Moodle, PHP, MySQL, Webpack, JavaScript) — Healthcare-focused e-learning: immersive v-classroom with video, slides and PDF in structured multimedia modules.
- [Made-to-measure order management for sales agents](https://casertano.name/progetti/ordini-su-misura-agenti-vendita/) (Angular, PHP, Vue 2, PWA, Microsoft SQL Server) — Offline-first shirt order management for sales agents, with automatic sync to the ERP on reconnection.
- [KeyPlex](https://casertano.name/progetti/keyplex/) (TypeScript, npm, Strategy Pattern, Terser) — Open-source TypeScript library for namespaced key-value storage with wildcard deletion and a minimal bundle.
- [LicensePluginJson](https://casertano.name/progetti/license-plugin-json/) (Vite, TypeScript, Rollup, GitHub Actions, Open Source) — Vite/Rollup plugin generating JSON license reports for automated open-source compliance.
- [MemoryX](https://casertano.name/progetti/memoryx/) (TypeScript, npm, Key-Value Store, Lodash) — In-memory browser key-value storage library with isolated namespaces, published on npm with TypeScript types.
